unextracted: a struct field; the extractor records types and callables, not fields
why:
issue 2036 (2026-10-25) — the field is READ now. Upstream has no such field: rclcpp delivers metadata by callback arity, and so does `create_subscription` here (a callback taking `const rclcpp::MessageInfo&` gets it; see `cpp:MessageInfo`). The field is kept for source compatibility, and the four-argument `create_subscription(topic, qos, cb, options)` reads it: `message_info = true` with a callback that takes no `MessageInfo` ABORTS the create naming `options.message_info`, the way a failed create does, because it would otherwise configure nothing. With a `MessageInfo` callback it changes nothing.

History: phase-428 W5 (2026-09-06) found it stored and read by nothing — a setter that compiled and configured nothing, the `NodeOptions` hazard RFC-0089 names. No disposition is written: there is no upstream candidate for clause 1 to act on.
